correctness.rationale: Read pinned RESULT.md, CHECK_HOMOLOGY.py and CHECK_CHARACTERS.py. Deleting root separates m stars, so Ind_2(T−x)=join of star factors K_q. Mayer--Vietoris on K_q=Δ(L)∪(y*D_q) with intersection discrete leaf set D_q gives H1 integral augmentation ker(sum:Z^q→Z), and K_q≃∨^{q−1}S1; q=1 is contractible. The root link L=B∪⋃_i(y_i*B_-i) with full leaf simplex B contracts G-equivariantly by sliding each y_i to the barycenter of B_-i (nonempty since m>=2, each q_i>=1), then B to its invariant barycenter; equivariant CW gluing makes root deletion a G-homotopy equivalence. Join Künneth gives top degree 2m−1, free tensor augmentation lattice; swapping degree-one join factors contributes (-1)^{(1+1)^2}=+1. A cyclic tensor permutation has trace equal to trace of monodromy on one factor, fixed leaf count minus one. Independently enumerated full induced-component allowable faces for seven small q vectors and checked their reduced Euler against the asserted top rank/sign. Direct finite Euler alone does not prove a full homotopy or integral module result; the construction above supplies it.
